title: Crypto Attribution Audit & Validation
system_under_test: GFIN PostgreSQL Database (gfin db, tables: telegram_wallets, telegram_intelligence, evidence, entity_links)

attribution_taxonomy.ON_CHAIN_FACT: Immutable blockchain transaction record (txid, block height, raw UTXO/state transition)
attribution_taxonomy.TRANSACTION: Transfer event with value, asset, fee, timestamp, and gas/fee metrics
attribution_taxonomy.COUNTERPARTY: Direct address sending to or receiving from the target address in a verified tx
attribution_taxonomy.SERVICE: Identified institutional wallet, exchange deposit/withdrawal address, bridge, or mixer
attribution_taxonomy.PROVIDER_LABEL: External attribution tag provided by Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or MISP
attribution_taxonomy.CLUSTER: Group of addresses aggregated via multi-input co-spending or deposit-reuse heuristics
attribution_taxonomy.INFERENCE: Probabilistic association derived from text mentions, chat logs, or unverified claims
attribution_taxonomy.IDENTITY: Verified real-world individual or corporate entity (KYC, subpoena, court order, signed PGP)
